summary: Connect Agile security controls to CI/CD evidence, triage findings and support release decisions. Explore the five-day DevSecOps training outline.
lede: DevSecOps training helps software engineers, security analysts and delivery leads connect security controls to Agile work and CI/CD release evidence. Participants practise mapping controls to delivery artefacts, triaging Semgrep and Trivy findings, and reviewing build provenance and component disclosures. They also create exception records and release checklists that document ownership, remediation and approval decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect software changes, security checks and release decisions in Agile delivery. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with development or CI/CD processes and need clearer control ownership and evidence.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with Agile software development, source-control workflows and CI/CD build or release processes is expected. No programming is required for the course exercises.
